title: refactor(ci): consolidate Node workflows, bump GitHub Actions, and deps hygiene
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: our repository has accumulated multiple near-duplicate GitHub Actions workflows for Node-based packages (ci-node-16.yml, ci-node-18.yml, release.yml glue jobs). This increases maintenance burden and prevents consistent cache and action-version hygiene. This PR consolidates the Node CI workflows into a single parameterized workflow, bumps GitHub Actions used across our CI (actions/checkout, actions/setup-node, cache actions) to the latest recommended minor versions, removes legacy matrix entries for EOL Node versions, and centralizes reusable workflow templates to reduce duplication.

What changed: consolidated .github/workflows/ci-node-*.yml into .github/workflows/ci-node.yml (parameterized), introduced .github/workflows/release-automation.yml with clearer gating, created .github/actions/cache-helpers (small composite action) to standardize caching across repos. Updated documentation in docs/ci.md to describe the new workflow parameters and migration steps. Bumped actions/setup-node to v4, actions/cache to v4, and replaced deprecated uses of actions/add-to-path.

Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows and remove duplicates - [x] Bump actions & remove deprecated usages - [x] Update repo-level cache keys to include node-version + lockfile hash - [x] Run full CI on redwood and selected subpackages - [x] Update docs/ci.md and team announcement draft

Testing & verification: ran the consolidated workflow across the monorepo with matrix [node: 18, 20], ran unit and lint pipelines for core packages, reran flaky test suites with increased timeouts (flake mitigation tracked in SRE-98). Verified release automation triggers remain identical for tags v* and the new workflow produces identical artifacts. Manually exercised the reusable cache action in redwood-sdk-python and redwood-sdk-typescript.

Rollout plan: merge to main, monitor CI success rate and run count for 72 hours, revert flag ready if unexpected failures increase. Post-merge: run a migration script to remove legacy workflow files in non-root repos via a follow-up PRs (small removals coordinated with repo owners).

Related: ENG-2214 has the consolidation design doc and cost analysis. SRE-98 tracks flaky test mitigations and cache improvements.

review_comments: Jordan Kim: Nice consolidation. Please ensure cache keys include lockfile hash to avoid cross-branch pollution. Also prefer actions/setup-node@v4 over v3 for improved caching behaviour.

Priya Srinivasan: Can we add an opt-in flag to skip certain heavy integration jobs for PRs coming from forks? Also pls confirm secrets usage for release workflow.
Ava Martinez: Added 'heavy_tests: true|false' parameter and defaulted to false for forked PRs. Release workflow continues to require repo secrets; documented in docs/ci.md.
Luca Moretti: Approved after minor nits about job names and timeout increases for known flaky suites.
Jordan Kim: Squash + merge after CI stabilization.
changes_summary: Reduced duplicated workflow files, standardized caching, and upgraded GH Actions versions to improve security and reliability. Introduced a reusable composite action for consistent cache handling and parameterized the CI matrix to simplify maintenance.
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows; bumped GitHub Actions versions for security and reliability; standardized cache keys across repository. No code behavioral changes.
